questions.question: What is the difference between ++$x and $x++ in PHP? / [CO2]
questions.solution_html:
• What is the difference between ++$x and $x++ in PHP? [A] / [CO2]
  • ++$x: Pre-increment → increment then use
  • $x++: Post-increment → use then increment
  • Example: $x=5; echo ++$x; //6, echo $x++; //5
  • Definition [1 mark] , Example [1 mark]

questions.question: State the difference between echo and print with example. / [CO1]
questions.solution_html:
• State the difference between echo and print with example. [K] / [CO1]
  • echo: Language construct, faster, multiple params, no return.
  • print: Function, returns 1, single argument.
  • Example:
  • echo "A","B"; → AB
  • print "A"."B"; → AB Differences 3 marks, Example 2 marks
